_about: Void Trader's English text, the template for a translation: copy this file to <code>.json (e.g. fr.json), set _language to the language's own name and translate each line. Keep {1}, {2} ... where they are: the game fills in a number or a name there, in that order. A line left as "" stays in English. A "_max_<key>" note gives the most letters a line may have on screen; a longer one stays in English. Guide: translations/README.md on the public repo.
